lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: *Huff... huff...!*
Syuen runs.
The moment she hears the news, she runs to the lab without stopping.
All sorts of thoughts go through her head.
"I never should've started the project."
"I never should've blamed Maxwell."
"I never should've said she lied."
She starts to despise herself.
She despises herself for yet again putting the things that matter most to her in danger, even after all this time,
and for being unable to do anything other than run so feebly.
Then the regret kicks in.
"If only I'd been more ruthless like Father and Jien, none of this would have happened!"
At the end of all that running...
*Bam! Boom!*
... she witnesses her own research lab go up in flames.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: No... no!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Maxwell...

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Maxwell's in there...!
Syuen rushes frantically toward the lab.

lines.speaker: womanresearcher
lines.text: Ms. Syuen! It's too dangerous!
The researchers block Syuen's path.

lines.speaker: womanresearcher
lines.text: The building's collapsing! You can't go in there!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Let go! Let go of me!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Maxwell's in there. You hear me? Maxwell's in there!

lines.speaker: womanresearcher
lines.text: The lead researcher is still inside?
*Boom! Crash!*
The building's entrance begins to cave in.
Watching the entrance collapse, Syuen sinks to the ground.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: What do I do...?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: If I lose Maxwell too, then...!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I'll be all alone again...!
As if in a trance, Syuen rises and starts to dart toward the collapsed entrance.

lines.speaker: womanresearcher
lines.text: Ms. Syuen!
The researchers rush over and drag her back.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: No...! No, no, no!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Let go! Let go of me!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Maxwell's in there! Hear me? She's in there!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I have to save her! I can't lose her like this!
Syuen pleads as she hangs from the arms holding her back.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Help... Please, somebody help!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Save Maxwell!
She begs, and begs again.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: *Sob...* Help... Please help!
She pleads to a world that has never once, in all her life, heard her cries for help.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Please help! I'm begging you!
And in that moment...
*Crash!*
... someone answers her call.
Syuen looks up to where the sound came from.

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: Heroic Leap!
Laplace crashes through a window and leaps down, with Maxwell in her arms.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: That's...!
*Thud!*
Laplace lands heroically on the ground.

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: All right, we made it out!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Maxwell!
Syuen runs toward the two of them.

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: Oh, Syuen!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Is... is Maxwell...?
Laplace lays the unconscious Maxwell down on the ground.

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: I think she fainted from shock when the blast went off.

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: But she's safe, so don't worry!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: You... you saved Maxwell?

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: That's right!

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: And it's all thanks to you.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Thanks to... me?

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: I heard you crying for help,

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: and that helped me locate a window through the smoke.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: You... heard me?

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: Of course! A hero must always heed the voice of someone calling for aid!

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: And above all, it was only because of the power you gave me that I was able to save Maxwell.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: The power... I gave you?

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: Yup!

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: It's all thanks to this body you gave me!

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: Thanks to you, I no longer run out of breath no matter how fast I run.

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: I don't collapse, even when surrounded by fire.

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: I don't get tired carrying someone while I run.

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: I don't even get hurt leaping from tall buildings.

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: Now that I'm no longer sick, and no longer weak,

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: I don't have to hesitate to save someone!

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: And all of that is thanks to the power you gave me!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: But why didn't you run away?

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: What do you mean? Why would I run away?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: They said the bodies would break down... that you'd die.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: There were all those terrible rumors going around...

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Aren't you afraid of dying?

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: Huh? Of course I'm afraid of dying!

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: But... you believed in me, right?

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: You gave me the power to be a hero!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: So I won't run away.

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: I promised! Remember?

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: I said that if you believed in me, I'd become your hero!

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: Give me just one chance.

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: If you believe in me,

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: then no matter what trials or difficulties may come,

lines.speaker: laplace_h
lines.text: I'll become a hero right before your eyes. Just watch!

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: So don't give up, Syuen.

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: Project Matis is guaranteed to succeed,

lines.speaker: laplace_proto
lines.text: because I'm going to become your hero! Just watch!
Laplace holds out her hand.
Syuen looks down at Laplace's hand,
and then up at her shining eyes.
The hero Nikke born from the blueprint Syuen created,
the only one who answered her call in a world where no one would help her,
is looking at her with the very same gaze as the heroes in those movies Syuen used to watch so long ago,
having now proved without a doubt...
She is a hero!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: ... Yeah, you're going to become a hero.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I'll make sure of it.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I'm going to bet everything on you.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Everyone in the world will think "hero" whenever they hear your name.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: No matter what it takes...
Syuen clasps Laplace's hand.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: ... I'm going to make you a hero!
Maxwell opens her eyes.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Where am I...?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: You're awake.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: I thought for sure I was gonna die in that fire.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Laplace grabbed you and jumped out of the lab.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: She did?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Know what she said? That she was only able to save you thanks to the power I gave her.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: ... And that she heard my voice calling for help.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: So, how did she look to you?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: ... Like a hero.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: See?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: There was never anything wrong with your blueprint.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Yeah. You were right.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: ... I'm sorry for calling you a liar.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Apology accepted!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: You're not going to waver like that anymore, right?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: No. No more hesitating.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: This all made it crystal clear to me.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I have to do everything I can in order to protect what's mine.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: It's the only way I won't lose what's most important to me.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: And as for you, don't go putting yourself in danger again. Got it?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Were you that worried?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Of course I was!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: When I thought you might die, I...!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: It's okay, it's okay.
Maxwell strokes Syuen's hair.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Thanks for worrying about me.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: By the way, I did manage to bring this out with me.
Maxwell takes out the medicine container she'd found.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: What is this?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: The thing that caused the experiment to fail... or at least, we think it did.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: We won't know the specifics until we analyze it, but at least we didn't come out of this empty-handed.
Syuen stares intently at the container.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: ... Yeah, this will work.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: It should be enough.
